{{PAGENAME}} is an elderly Roya found at the Roya Frostland camps who speaks about a [[Glommoth]].

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:;'''Ulfrida''' Have you ever seen a "Glommoth," child?

==Dialogue==
:'''Ulfrida:''' Have you ever seen a "Glommoth," child?
:{{DIcon}} A Glommoth?
:{{DIcon}} I'm not from around here... 
:'''Ulfrida:''' Ah, forgive my eagerness. I am Ulfrida. Folk here once called me a "Cryptozoologist."
:'''Ulfrida:''' Would you like to hear a story about a Glommoth?
:{{DIcon|Option}} (Listen)
::'''Ulfrida:''' It happened when I was just a girl. Lost on the ice I was, gathering herbs, when the avalanche struck.
::'''Ulfrida:''' I ran, but found no place to hide. I could only watch as the mountain of snow came for me...
::'''Ulfrida:''' And then... it appeared. With its great tusks it shattered the falling stone. With its body, it shielded me from the snow.
::'''Ulfrida:''' When the roar was gone, the Glommoth raised its trunk and blew, pointing in the direction I was to go. And in its eyes I saw... a guarded, lonely depth.
::'''Ulfrida:''' There I stood, in fear or awe, I cannot say... until it turned and faded back into the storm.
::'''Ulfrida:''' ...Heh. Sounds a tale spun from dream-stuff, does it not?
::'''Ulfrida:''' I was just a girl at the time. No image could I keep, no trail could I follow. But in my bones, I know what I saw.
::'''Ulfrida:''' I have looked for it ever since, but never have I found it...
::{{DIcon}} Maybe it doesn't actually exist?
::{{DIcon}} Maybe it was just your imagination?
::'''Ulfrida:''' I believe what I saw.
::'''Ulfrida:''' Older than we know is Solaris. Grander. Full of mysteries our minds cannot hold.
::'''Ulfrida:''' Now my hope lies in the Spacetrek Collective's technology to confirm its existence... I want to hear news of the creature as soon as it's found. That's why I live here.
::'''Ulfrida:''' If you ever meet it, do tell me... May the Soliskin protect you, child of Solaris.
:{{DIcon|Exit}} I'm a bit busy right now...
{{Dialogue End}}
